source_policy: Reference concepts only; no original schema or patient-record reuse claimed

poe: provider-order categories and transaction concepts; no direct field mapping

adaptations: All records, SQL types and constraints are authored
patients/admissions retain MIMIC-inspired patient/stay grains; optional profile/detail split-storage tables are authored
No generic object, object_type or clinical_order tables are present
Laboratory, medication and procedure orders are distinct business identities with independent local ID namespaces
Occurrence records are normalized through the appropriate order FK; history uses exactly one of three declared FKs
emar integer identity and procedureevent_id are authored simplifications
Identity group answers are private evaluation annotations, not input DB tables
